package coverage_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	svc "example.com/coverage/gen/coverage"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type (
	audit struct {
		client bool
		phase  string
	}
	pipe[In, Out any] struct {
		received Out
		sent     In
		closed   bool
	}
)

func (a audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, info *svc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	enabled := a.phase == "all"
	switch info.CallType() {
	case loom.InterceptorUnary:
		if enabled || a.phase == "payload" {
			p := info.Payload()
			p.SetValue(p.Value() + ":payload")
		}
	case loom.InterceptorStreamingSend:
		if enabled || a.phase == "send" {
			if a.client {
				p := info.ClientStreamingPayload()
				p.SetValue(p.Value() + ":send")
			} else {
				r := info.ServerStreamingResult()
				r.SetValue(r.Value() + ":send")
			}
		}
	}
	res, err := next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if info.CallType() == loom.InterceptorStreamingRecv && (enabled || a.phase == "recv") {
		if a.client {
			r := info.ClientStreamingResult(res)
			r.SetValue(r.Value() + ":recv")
		} else {
			p := info.ServerStreamingPayload(res)
			p.SetValue(p.Value() + ":recv")
		}
	}
	return res, nil
}

func (p *pipe[In, Out]) Send(v In) error {
	p.sent = v
	return nil
}

func (p *pipe[In, Out]) SendWithContext(_ context.Context, v In) error {
	return p.Send(v)
}

func (p *pipe[In, Out]) Recv() (Out, error) {
	return p.received, nil
}

func (p *pipe[In, Out]) RecvWithContext(context.Context) (Out, error) {
	return p.Recv()
}

func (p *pipe[In, Out]) Close() error {
	p.closed = true
	return nil
}

func TestClientStreamingAccessorCoverage(t *testing.T) {
	for _, phase := range []string{"payload", "send", "recv"} {
		t.Run(phase, func(t *testing.T) {
			wire := &pipe[*svc.CStreamingPayload, *svc.CResult]{received: &svc.CResult{Value: "result"}}
			client := svc.NewClient(nil, nil, func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
				if phase == "payload" {
					require.Equal(t, "opening:payload", p.(*svc.CPayload).Value)
				}
				return wire, nil
			}, audit{client: true, phase: phase})
			require.NotPanics(t, func() {
				stream, err := client.C(context.Background(), &svc.CPayload{Value: "opening"})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				if phase == "send" {
					require.NoError(t, stream.SendWithContext(context.Background(), &svc.CStreamingPayload{Value: "message"}))
					require.Equal(t, "message:send", wire.sent.Value)
				}
				if phase == "recv" {
					res, err := stream.RecvWithContext(context.Background())
					require.NoError(t, err)
					require.Equal(t, "result:recv", res.Value)
				}
				require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
				require.True(t, wire.closed)
			})
		})
	}
}

func TestSharedStreamControls(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("client-overlap", func(t *testing.T) {
		wire := &pipe[*svc.AStreamingPayload, *svc.AResult]{received: &svc.AResult{Value: "result"}}
		client := svc.NewClient(func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
			require.Equal(t, "opening:payload", p.(*svc.APayload).Value)
			return wire, nil
		}, nil, nil, audit{client: true, phase: "all"})
		stream, err := client.A(context.Background(), &svc.APayload{Value: "opening"})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.NoError(t, stream.Send(&svc.AStreamingPayload{Value: "message"}))
		require.Equal(t, "message:send", wire.sent.Value)
		res, err := stream.Recv()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, "result:recv", res.Value)
		require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
		require.True(t, wire.closed)
	})
	t.Run("server-carrier", func(t *testing.T) {
		wire := &pipe[*svc.AResult, *svc.AStreamingPayload]{received: &svc.AStreamingPayload{Value: "message"}}
		endpoint := svc.WrapAEndpoint(func(ctx context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
			input := p.(*svc.AEndpointInput)
			require.Equal(t, "opening:payload", input.Payload.Value)
			message, err := input.Stream.RecvWithContext(ctx)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, "message:recv", message.Value)
			require.NoError(t, input.Stream.SendWithContext(ctx, &svc.AResult{Value: "result"}))
			require.NoError(t, input.Stream.Close())
			return nil, nil
		}, audit{phase: "all"})
		_, err := endpoint(context.Background(), &svc.AEndpointInput{Payload: &svc.APayload{Value: "opening"}, Stream: wire})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, "result:send", wire.sent.Value)
		require.True(t, wire.closed)
	})
}
